name: clipboard-image-paste
description: Save a clipboard image as a local PNG and paste an @path reference into Codex or Claude Code CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Paste clipboard images into CLI prompts as local image references.
interface.longDescription: Windows helper for Codex and Claude Code CLI sessions. It saves the current clipboard bitmap to a local PNG file, copies a prompt-safe image path, and can make Ctrl+V paste images quickly in terminal sessions.
defaultPrompt: Paste the image currently on my clipboard.
Save my clipboard image and attach it here.
